experiment_data.hypothesis: Depth signal persists at 7B+ scale: Qwen3-8B-Base generation chains exhibit DDR patterns (drifting central-tendency, stationary shape features) comparable to sub-3B models, and adding Qwen3-8B as 9th generator to LOGO evaluation maintains or improves ensemble F1, ruling out scale-dependent signal collapse
